newsitem.title: UK: Spending plans ensure UK meets EMU target - Brown.
newsitem.headline: Spending plans ensure UK meets EMU target - Brown.

text.p: Gordon Brown, finance spokesman for Britain's opposition Labour party, said his plans for Britain's public finances would enable the country to meet the debt criteria for participation in a single European currency.

"I have made the decisions on public spending, about the rigorous control of priorities and the level of public spending," he told Reuters Financial Television. "I have announced the cash totals for this year and for next year. I have announced a system of public expenditure planning...that I believe will be welcome. These proposals will of course in my view allow us to be within the Maastricht criteria."
